Mango Martini
By: Giangi Townsend
Published: Thursday, February 14, 2013 - 4:51am

Ingredients




45 ml Grey Goose Vodka
15 ml Triple Sec
10 oz Fresh Mangos (or frozen thaw them before using)

Preparation

1 Mix the Vodka with Triple Sec in a martini shaker or container. 2 Puree the mangos and add them to the Vodka and Triple sec. Let them infuse together in the refrigerator until ready to use. 3 Add crushed ice to the Vodka Mango mixture, shake well and stir into cold glasses. 4 If less pulp is desired, add cranberry juice to the mix and strain when ready to enjoy it.

About

As we always celebrate Valentine’s Day with a dinner with our son the night before the actual celebratory night, last night I decided to add a drink to the mix.  Having  fresh mangoes I had fun creating my version of a Mango Martini. Pretty smooth and tasty.
